# JutJut

> JutJut is an Australian platform that helps high school students turn verified skills, grades, and credentials into part-time jobs, university pathways, and weekly local perks. Free for students. Always.

## What JutJut does

JutJut connects three groups:

- **Students** — build a verified digital skills profile ("My Kit") containing teacher-verified skills, report card grades, and credentials. Use it to apply for jobs with one click, submit to universities via the YourWay portal, and access weekly perks from local businesses.
- **Employers** — post part-time and casual jobs, browse verified student profiles, and hire with confidence knowing skills have been independently verified by teachers and coaches.
- **Schools and Universities** — manage student verification requests, view cohort analytics, and receive verified skill submissions for admissions.

## Key features

- **My Kit** — a student's verified digital profile. Skills are confirmed by teachers or coaches with a green tick. Employers see only what the student chooses to share.
- **The Drop** — a weekly perks board. Local businesses post exclusive discounts and offers for JutJut students. New drops every Monday.
- **YourWay** — a university pathway portal. Students submit their verified My Kit as evidence of skills and character alongside academic results.
- **Jobs Board** — employer-posted part-time and casual jobs, searchable by location and role type.
- **Squads** — student groups for team-based skill verification and peer accountability.

## Pricing

- Students: Free forever.
- Employers: Starter ($0/month, 1 active listing), Growth ($49/month, 5 listings + analytics), Scale ($149/month, unlimited listings + featured placement + priority support).

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is JutJut really free for students?**
Yes — 100% free for students, forever. Revenue comes from employers who post jobs, not from students.

**How does skill verification work?**
A teacher, coach, or employer logs in and confirms the student's skill directly on JutJut. Once verified, it shows a green tick on the student's My Kit profile.

**What is The Drop?**
The Drop is a weekly perks board. Local businesses post exclusive discounts, freebies, and offers just for JutJut students. New drops every Monday.

**Can I use JutJut to apply for university?**
Yes. The YourWay portal lets students submit their verified My Kit directly to participating universities as evidence of skills and character alongside academic results.

**Is student data safe?**
Student data belongs to the student. JutJut never sells it. Students can delete their account and all associated data at any time from their settings.
